mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_event (user_mis, user_name, event_type, stage_id, stage_name, occurred_at) VALUES (#{userMis}, #{userName}, #{eventType}, #{stageId}, #{stageName}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_mis, user_name, event_type, stage_id, stage_name, occurred_at, deleted_flag, add_time, update_time FROM activity_event WHERE deleted_flag = 0 ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM activity_event WHERE occurred_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
